text: The future of AI is a topic that many people discuss today. Most experts agree that artificial intelligence will become much more powerful in the coming years. Some researchers are working on general AI, also called AGI, which could understand and learn any task like a human. This technology may bring great benefits, such as better healthcare and smarter transport. However, there are also serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Nobody knows exactly when AGI will arrive. Some predict it within ten years, while others believe it is still far away. Because of this, governments and companies are now trying to manage AI development carefully.
